a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us under 4. Only 4 cells exist, so only one of us can be safe right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and want to say so openly rather than surprise you. If you take too, the split is random. If you see a better option, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. I'm sorry this breaks our plan, but the storm odds made it unworkable. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4 too.
